workspace-deny.label: L1 · writes denied in the workspace only
workspace-deny.profile:
;; PROTOTYPE (issue #124) — macOS seatbelt profile, posture L1: "the workspace is the only thing
;; the learning session cannot write".
;;
;; Read everything, write everything EXCEPT the workspace subtree. One rule; no allow-list, so
;; whatever a skill needs anywhere else on the machine keeps working.
;;
;; `/Users/veno/Projects/derivon-research/derivon-mindmap/prototype/isolation-decision/.scratch/workspace` must be the *canonical* path (realpath). macOS spells /tmp, /var and /etc
;; through symlinks, and a rule written against the symlink spelling matches nothing — see the
;; "misconfiguration" section of evidence.json, which measures exactly that leak.
(version 1)
(allow default)
(deny file-write* (subpath "/Users/veno/Projects/derivon-research/derivon-mindmap/prototype/isolation-decision/.scratch/workspace"))

write-allowlist.label: L2 · writes denied everywhere except an allow-list
write-allowlist.profile:
;; PROTOTYPE (issue #124) — macOS seatbelt profile, posture L2: "the learning session cannot
;; write anywhere except the few places it is told it may".
;;
;; This is the posture that answers the motivation the ticket was opened with — today a granted
;; skill script can `rm -rf ~` — rather than only the acceptance criterion (the workspace).
;;
;; Seatbelt takes the LAST matching rule, so the order here is the design: deny all writes, hand
;; back the places a session legitimately writes, then re-deny the workspace in case one of those
;; grants overlaps it (a TMPDIR inside the workspace, say).
;;
;; `/Users/veno/Projects/derivon-research/derivon-mindmap/prototype/isolation-decision/.scratch/workspace` must be canonical; `/Users/veno` and `/var/folders/4n/q_yw447x7m1645mcpr96rbg40000gn/T` come from the real environment.
(version 1)
(allow default)

(deny file-write*)

;; Pi and the shell need these two or nothing runs.
(allow file-write* (literal "/dev/null") (literal "/dev/stdout") (literal "/dev/stderr") (literal "/dev/dtracehelper"))

;; Scratch space: TMPDIR, and the system temp roots behind it.
(allow file-write* (subpath "/var/folders/4n/q_yw447x7m1645mcpr96rbg40000gn/T"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "/private/var/folders"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "/private/tmp"))
(allow file-write* (subpath "/tmp"))

;; The user-level root: models.json, auth.json, selected-models.json, the skills and the node
;; shim live here, and the companion maintains them (ADR-0010, ADR-0013).
(allow file-write* (subpath "/Users/veno/Projects/derivon-research/derivon-mindmap/prototype/isolation-decision/.scratch/config-root"))

;; The application's own data directory: learner records are application data keyed by workspace
;; (ADR-0009), and the learning session's commands write them.
(allow file-write* (subpath "/Users/veno/Projects/derivon-research/derivon-mindmap/prototype/isolation-decision/.scratch/appdata"))

;; The workspace is content, and learning mode reads it and never writes it — whatever the rules
;; above granted.
(deny file-write* (subpath "/Users/veno/Projects/derivon-research/derivon-mindmap/prototype/isolation-decision/.scratch/workspace"))
